comparator.sourceNotes: The selected full-time Germany Studies pathway closes 60+60+60. Its required 30-EC abroad semester is separate from 30 EC of genuine free profiling, and the 12-EC thesis is counted once. Diagnostic test 109121025Y and recurring tutoring 12202A025Y are mandatory zero-credit formation and do not increase the total. Current evidence supports Dutch and German instruction while retaining Dutch catalogue-language qualifications.
